narrative.summary: An automatically built and tested assistant was developed, achieving a baseline training pass rate of 75%. After optimization, the assistant maintained a training pass rate of 75% and scored 75% on the holdout cases, which consisted of 4 instances. The performance on the holdout cases is too few to generalize from.
narrative.limitations: The assistant has 5 known failures and a judge calibration that did not pass. Additionally, the evaluation set is small, with only 4 holdout cases.
